headline: Turkey Gross External Debt Reaches Record $549.2 Billion in Third Quarter
summary: Official data showed Turkey's gross external debt stock rose to a record $549.2 billion in Q3 2026. Separately, November consumer confidence recovered slightly to 86.8 while overseas producer prices rose 33.45% annually in October.
why: Turkey's external debt load and foreign investment metrics shape its fiscal vulnerabilities, balance of payments, and sovereign credit ratings.
